name: Aekuni Shrine
text: Aekuni Shrine (敢國神社, Aekuni-jinja) is a Shinto shrine located in the city of Iga, Mie Prefecture, Japan. It is the Ichinomiya of the former Iga Province and claims to have been founded in the seventh century. It is classified as a Beppo Shrine by the Association of Shinto Shrines.

depictions.name: Aekuni Shrine
depictions.text: Aekuni Shrine is a Shinto shrine in the city of Iga, which served as the of the province during the Sengoku period.
